description: Meituan LongCat 2.0 trillion-parameter MoE agentic model for coding, agent workflows, and ultra-long context tasks. Open-sourced under MIT license with 1M token context window. The official LongCat docs of 2026-11-01 no longer list LongCat 2.0 as a supported model: the quick start supported-model table, the API pay-as-you-go page and the model-parameter comparison all cover LongCat 2.5 Preview only, and the /pricing/longcat-2.0 page survives only as an older docs build. Kept for migration reference; migrate to LongCat 2.5 Preview (longcat-2.5-preview).
